name: Elastic Security
summary: Elastic Security is Elastic's SIEM, with 400 or more prebuilt integrations and case management listed on its product page. Elastic's pricing page describes hosted, serverless and self-managed options, but the text we read shows no prices.

facts.text: Elastic says Security supports 400 or more prebuilt integrations and up to 1,000 security and data source integrations in total.
Vendor page: Elastic recommends detection rules developed by Elastic Security Labs and validated by the community, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
Attack Discovery correlates alerts into prioritized attack narratives, the page says.
On the vendor's page, an investigation timeline is assembled before the analyst is notified, and case management and incident response with approval gates are listed.

plans.name: Hosted and serverless
plans.notes: Billed pay as you go monthly or prepaid, per the pricing page. No prices appear in the text we read.

plans.name: Self-managed Platinum
plans.notes: License-based subscription tier. No price appears in the text we read.

plans.name: Self-managed Enterprise
plans.notes: License-based subscription tier. No price appears in the text we read.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page text shows no figures for any plan, and it does not state a billing period for self-managed licenses.
The page offers a free trial but the text we read gives no length for it.
